banner.title: New to Legacy Vault?
banner.subtitle: Follow an interactive step-by-step walkthrough to master vault creation, beneficiary assignment, and digital asset encryption.

firstTimePrompt.question: Are you new to Legacy Vault?
firstTimePrompt.subtitle: We are honored to guide you. Our system will walk you through each button and basic action to create your first digital heritage vault effortlessly and with complete security.
firstTimePrompt.helper: You can always relaunch this interactive tour or open the guidebook anytime from the navigation bar.

congrats.title: 🎉 Congratulations! You've completed the tutorial!
congrats.subtitle: You have mastered the foundations of digital estate preservation.
congrats.text: Your assets are now safeguarded by AES-256 military-grade encryption standards. You can freely create additional vaults, designate heirs, or explore advanced fail-safes like DMS and AI OCR Forensics.

step1.title: Select "New Vault"
step1.instruction: Click the '+ New Vault' button to begin. A vault is an encrypted private sanctuary where you preserve your most important credentials and digital heritage.
step1.tip: Each vault possesses an independent encryption key and can be delegated to distinct beneficiaries.

step2.title: Fill in "Vault Information"
step2.instruction: Provide a memorable, meaningful name for the vault (e.g. 'Family Heritage', 'Crypto & Investments') along with an optional handover note.
step2.tip: A descriptive name helps your heirs immediately understand the purpose and intent when the vault unlocks.

step3.title: Assign "Beneficiaries"
step3.instruction: Enter the email address of a loved one or trusted trustee. This individual will receive the decryption authorization when the transfer workflow triggers.
step3.tip: You can designate multiple beneficiaries and customize permissions for each family member.

step4.title: Choose "Asset Type"
step4.instruction: Select the appropriate asset category: Bank accounts, Crypto wallets, Social media accounts, Insurance policies, or Confidential legal dossiers.
step4.tip: Each asset category features a specialized, standardized form to ensure your heirs receive all essential details accurately.

step5.title: Enter "Asset Information"
step5.instruction: Enter identifiers and confidential secrets (passwords, PINs, seed phrases, notes). All secrets are client-side end-to-end encrypted (E2E AES-256) before leaving your browser.
step5.tip: Zero-knowledge architecture ensures that neither servers nor administrators can ever read your plaintext secrets.

step6.title: Click "Create Vault" to finish
step6.instruction: Review your entered details and click 'Create Vault' to securely seal your digital estate!
step6.tip: After creation, you can configure your Dead Man's Switch (DMS) check-in intervals or invite legal executors.

steps.title: Vault Creation & End-to-End Encryption (E2E Vault)
steps.subtitle: Safeguard confidential credentials with AES-256 military-grade encryption
steps.description: Digital vaults are where you preserve your vital digital estate: bank logins, seed phrases, crypto keys, and legal documents. Sensitive assets are encrypted locally before transmission — neither servers nor administrators can ever read your secrets.
points: Zero-knowledge End-to-End Encryption: Only you and authorized heirs hold the decryption keys
8 tailored asset types: Bank Accounts, Cryptocurrencies, Social Accounts, Legal Papers, etc.
Domain separation: Create separate vaults for Family, Business, and Financial portfolios
steps.tip: Pro Tip: Start by clicking '+ New Vault' and protecting your highest-priority credentials first.

steps.title: Beneficiaries & Executors (Guardians & Heirs)
steps.subtitle: Establish a transparent, tamper-proof succession framework
steps.description: LegacyVault cleanly separates the people who receive assets from those who verify legal conditions. You maintain granular control over who inherits each asset and who executes legal obligations.
points: Beneficiary: Inherits specified assets and documents when the vault unlocks
Executor: Conducts field verification, files legal notices, and assists distribution
Flexible distribution rules: Full, split percentage, sole heir, or multi-party consensus (Shamir)
steps.tip: Pro Tip: Designate trusted loved ones as Beneficiaries, and trusted legal counsel as Executors.

steps.title: Automated Fail-Safe (Dead Man's Switch - DMS)
steps.subtitle: Hand over assets at the exact right moment with zero accidental triggers
steps.description: The system continuously tracks your presence via periodic check-ins (1-click via Email or Web). If you miss your schedule, an escalating 3-tier verification procedure verifies your status before any assets unlock.
points: Frictionless 1-click check-in from email or web dashboard
Cross-confirmers: Trusted contacts verify real-world circumstances before activation
3-tier escalation warnings: Timely reminders sent before any grace period expires
steps.tip: Pro Tip: Always add at least one trusted Confirmer to prevent unintended activations.

steps.title: AI OCR Forensics & Multi-Modal Asset Verifiers
steps.subtitle: Ensure authenticity, integrity, and proof of ownership before estate transfer
steps.description: LegacyVault features advanced digital forensics to verify identity, ownership, and document legality:
points: AI OCR Death Certificate Forensics (Gemini 3.6 Flash): Automatic extraction of deceased name, extract number, issuing authority, and red seal
Crypto Wallet Personal Sign: Cryptographically prove MetaMask control via secp256k1 ecRecover without revealing private keys
OTP Email & SMS Sandbox Verifier: Real-time ownership verification of emails and mobile wallets
Digital Asset Fingerprints: Instant detection if stored assets have been altered after verification
steps.tip: Pro Tip: Open any Vault detail page and click the asset status badges to test the verification tools!
